name: ai-mafia
description: AI Mafia — real-time multiplayer social deduction game

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @ai-mafia/server && npm run build --workspace @ai-mafia/web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @ai-mafia/server && npm run build --workspace @ai-mafia/web && npm run test --workspace @ai-mafia/e2e
